provenance.observed: 2026-11-11T06:49Z..10:04Z; all six shards green in every source run
provenance.module_seconds: Per module, the median over the source runs of the wall time between its CI_MODULE start record and its CI_MODULE summary record inside the 'Run repository test shard' step (scripts.ci_pytest_timing). Includes module-scoped fixture setup and teardown; excludes per-shard collection.
provenance.shard_base_seconds: Per matrix index, the median wall time from job start to the start of 'Run repository test shard'. Index 0 also runs the shard-0-only composition checks and index 5 the native admission gate; uniform per-shard costs (setup, collection) shift every shard equally and do not affect placement.
provenance.default_module_seconds: Mean of the measured module medians; applied to any included module absent from this table.
provenance.refresh: Re-derive from at least five recent green merge-group runs when the shard steps or the test mix change materially (for example after in-shard xdist). Placement only: coverage is still verified exactly by verify_partition.
provenance.module_overhead_seconds: Sum over the six shards of the median time from the shard plan line to the first CI_MODULE start (pytest collection/import), divided by the number of measured modules; added to every module's weight so placement also balances per-module collection cost.
